mines.mine_notes: Development-stage copper-gold project, northwestern British Columbia (100%). One of the world's largest undeveloped copper-gold resources. 2025: site investigation and early works continued. P&P reserves (May 26, 2022; 2022 PFS open pit LOM plan): 2,292 Mt @ 0.64 g/t Au, 0.14% Cu, 2.2 g/t Ag, 76 ppm Mo = 47.3 Moz Au, 7,320 Mlb Cu, 160 Moz Ag, 385 Mlb Mo (proven 1,297 Mt @ 0.71 g/t; probable 995 Mt @ 0.55 g/t). No production in FY2025.

notes: 2025 AIF + MD&A used (year ended December 31, 2025). Development-stage company: no production, no mining revenue. FY2025: working capital $109.8M; cash $117.5M; net loss $53.2M ($0.53/share). Company-wide M&I gold resources 101.2 Moz + 81.8 Moz inferred (107.4M shares outstanding). Other projects: Courageous Lake (NWT), Iskut (BC; 2025: 23 holes/22,498 m at Snip North), Snowstorm (Nevada). All amounts in CAD unless noted (financials); reserves in metric.
